items.headline: Modest numbers in Week 8 win
items.text: Daniels completed 16 of 29 passes for 217 yards and a touchdown while rushing twice for 23 yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

items.headline: Ties career high in rushing yards
items.text: Warren rushed 17 times for 143 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of two targets for no gain in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

items.headline: Cashes in goal-line TD in Week 7
items.text: Perine rushed four times for 16 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens.

items.headline: Only two receptions in Week 8
items.text: Pickens tallied two catches (on four targets) for 48 yards during Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Cardinals.

items.headline: Forgettable afternoon in loss
items.text: London brought in one of six targets for eight yards in the Falcons' 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.headline: Five grabs in Denver
items.text: Kelce caught five of seven targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

items.headline: Scores fifth TD in Week 8 win
items.text: Diggs caught three of six targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-10 win over the Eagles.

items.headline: Zero catches in rain-soaked win
items.text: Godwin failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

items.headline: Not available for Week 8
items.text: Henderson (illness) has been downgraded from questionable to out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports.

items.headline: Tosses one TD in Paris
items.text: Shough completed 30 of 38 passes for 278 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers. He added seven rushing yards on three carries.

items.headline: Dealing with mild hamstring strain
items.text: McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

items.headline: Efficient with expanded opportunity
items.text: Black rushed 12 times for 63 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of three targets for minus-4 yards in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday. He also lost a fumble and returned one kickoff for 34 yards.

items.headline: Chance to practice in Week 9
items.text: Head coach Kellen Moore said that Etienne (hamstring) will be evaluated Monday before the Saints make a determination whether he practices this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

items.headline: Loses starting gig, now No. 3 QB
items.text: Head coach Mike LaFleur said that Brissett will be removed from the starting role and serve as the Cardinals' No. 3 quarterback in Sunday's game in Seattle, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

items.headline: Career-high 147 rushing yards in Week 8
items.text: Allen rushed 21 times for 147 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for six yards in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

items.headline: Five catches in blowout win
items.text: Bernard caught all five of his targets for 30 yards during Sunday's 27-6 win against Cleveland.

items.headline: First 100-yard game of season
items.text: Chase secured 11 of 16 targets for 141 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 43-36 overtime win over the Titans on Sunday.

items.headline: Team-high yardage total in loss
items.text: McConkey brought in four of six targets for 86 yards in the Chargers' 24-9 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

items.headline: Heavy workload as pass catcher Sunday
items.text: Kamara carried the ball six times for five yards and caught all seven of his targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

items.headline: Modest production in Week 8 win
items.text: Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

items.headline: Locked down in Week 8
items.text: Pitts caught two of five targets for six yards during Sunday's 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers.

items.headline: Status uncertain for Week 9
items.text: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he has "no significant update" on the status of Montgomery (groin) heading into a Week 9 matchup with the Chargers, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

items.headline: Steps up late as team's top RB
items.text: White rushed 11 times for 55 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for five yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

items.headline: Makes strong case for top job
items.text: Coleman carried the ball 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown and caught four of five targets for 63 yards in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

items.headline: Makes key grabs in Week 8 win
items.text: Waddle caught three of six targets for 39 yards and a touchdown and added a two-point conversion in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

items.headline: Finds end zone against Detroit
items.text: Hockenson caught four of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-15 loss to the Lions.

items.headline: Reaches paydirt in Week 8
items.text: Downs caught four of five targets for 23 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.

items.headline: Career-best day in loss
items.text: Fannin brought in 10 of 12 targets for 154 yards in the Browns' 27-6 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

items.headline: Finds end zone in Paris
items.text: Vele caught all five of his targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

items.headline: Four grabs in defeat
items.text: Douglas caught four of six targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

items.headline: Begins running, but lacks timetable
items.text: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

items.headline: Records two total TDs on Sunday
items.text: Prescott was 19-for-29 passing for 195 yards, one touchdown and no interceptions while rushing seven times for 20 yards and one more TD during Sunday's 33-30 overtime defeat to the Cardinals.

items.headline: Manages solid rushing total in shutout
items.text: Robinson rushed 19 times for 76 yards and failed to bring in his only target in the Falcons' 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.headline: Grinds out yards, TD in win
items.text: Swift rushed 22 times for 78 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 12 yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.

items.headline: Blanked with top two QBs injured
items.text: Flowers failed to bring in any of his five targets in the Ravens' 36-10 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

items.headline: Picturesque TD catch in loss
items.text: Jefferson brought in five of nine targets for 33 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

items.headline: Ties season high with 57 rec yards
items.text: Robinson caught six of seven targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He also lost a fumble.

items.headline: Back in end zone during win
items.text: Kraft secured all six targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

items.headline: Leading rusher in Week 8 loss
items.text: Gordon carried the ball 19 times for 69 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots. He failed to catch his only target.

items.headline: Clutch TD toss in win
items.text: Goff completed 18 of 25 passes for 176 yards with a touchdown and an interception and added three carries for no gain in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

items.headline: No targets in Week 8
items.text: Cooper did not garner a target during Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

items.headline: Two TD passes in OT loss
items.text: Stroud completed 17 of 28 passes for 153 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants. He added two rushing attempts for four yards and threw a successful two-point conversion.

items.headline: Gets first TD with Texans
items.text: Harrison caught one of four targets for a six-yard touchdown in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

items.headline: Could 'potentially' play in 2026
items.text: When asked Monday if Conner (foot) will play this season, coach Mike LaFleur said "potentially," Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

items.headline: Still targeting December return
items.text: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

items.headline: Rushing TD in loss
items.text: Henry rushed 11 times for 53 yards and a touchdown and brought in both targets for seven yards in the Ravens' 36-10 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

items.headline: Expected to remain with team
items.text: Head coach Matt LaFleur said Monday that the Packers are aware of the prior physical abuse allegations involving Jacobs that recently surfaced and "anticipate him being a member" of the team moving forward, Ryan Wood of USA Today reports.

items.headline: Managing rib soreness ahead of Week 9
items.text: Packers passing game coordinator Jason Vrable said Monday that Watson (ribs) is sore but "doing great," Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Quiet game with eight touches
items.text: St. Brown secured seven of eight targets for 46 yards and rushed once for 10 yards in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

items.headline: Another productive performance
items.text: McBride hauled in seven of eight targets for 72 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 33-30 overtime victory at Dallas.

items.headline: Comes back to Earth in Week 8 loss
items.text: Concepcion caught three of four targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers.

items.headline: Does little with eight carries
items.text: Mason rushed eight times for 20 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

items.headline: Three total TDs in Week 8 win
items.text: Allen completed 21 of 34 passes for 289 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens. He added 30 rushing yards and a rushing touchdown on seven rushing attempts.

items.headline: Tops 20 carries again
items.text: Williams churned out 56 yards on 24 carries and notched one catch (on two targets) for one yard during Sunday's 33-30 overtime defeat to the Cardinals.

items.headline: Has TD called back, finishes with 5-64
items.text: Shakir caught five of six targets for 64 yards in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens.

items.headline: Catches TD in overtime loss
items.text: Flournoy caught three of four targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Cardinals.

items.headline: Solid all-around day in OT win
items.text: Brown rushed 12 times for 55 yards and brought in eight of nine targets for 46 yards in the Bengals' 43-36 overtime win over the Titans on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

items.headline: Stays hot in Week 9 win
items.text: Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and recovered a fumble in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

items.headline: Overshadowed by rookie backup in Week 8 loss
items.text: Walker carried the ball 21 times for 69 yards and caught four of five targets for 15 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

items.headline: Nets just 27 scrimmage yards in loss
items.text: Hampton rushed nine times for 20 yards and brought in two of three targets for seven yards in the Chargers' 24-9 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

items.headline: Disappointing production in Week 7
items.text: Higbee caught two of three targets for 14 yards during Sunday's 35-21 win over the Raiders.

items.headline: Season-best effort in win
items.text: Burden brought in all four targets for 130 yards and a touchdown and rushed once for seven yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.

items.headline: Five catches in win
items.text: Williams caught five of seven targets for 54 yards during Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

items.headline: Six total TDs in wild win
items.text: Burrow completed 38 of 48 passes for 462 yards with five touchdowns and three interceptions and added three carries for 10 yards and another score in the Bengals' 43-36 overtime win over the Titans on Sunday.

items.headline: Rushing TD in big win
items.text: Dowdle rushed 15 times for 56 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

items.headline: Dealing with 'new' ankle injury
items.text: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love suffered a "new" ankle injury during Sunday's overtime win at Dallas, and that he'll have an update on the running back later this week, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Targeted 12 times in Week 8 loss
items.text: Wilson caught six of 12 targets for 83 yards in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

items.headline: Scores twice in Week 8 win
items.text: Bowers caught seven of 10 targets for 92 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

items.headline: Tosses two TDs in loss to Pats
items.text: Willis completed 21 of 32 passes for 211 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 24-19 loss to New England. He gained two rushing yards on his only carry.
